newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico privatizes Cabo San Lucas port.
newsitem.headline: Mexico privatizes Cabo San Lucas port.

text.p: Mexico granted a 25-year operating concession for its Cabo San Lucas port to Baja Mantenimiento y Operaciones SA, the Communications and Transport Ministry said on Wednesday in a statement.
The Pacific coast resort on the Baja California peninsula is mostly a tourist port, and is the latest in a series of ports to be privatized.
The ministry said the concession will assume expansion, upkeep, maintenance and regulations of tariffs.
The price paid for operating rights was not provided. The concession was granted last week, the ministry said.
